children: AstraZeneca has a robust and diverse portfolio, with strong opportunities in its pipeline, analysts at Berenberg say in a note. The pharmaceutical company is on track to deliver 13% return on research and development investment for its current pipeline cohort, they say. There have been some failures of highly anticipated readouts in 2026, but these were offset by other positive results, highlighting the importance of having a diverse portfolio, they add. Shares are up 2.25% at $163.78. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
